title: About
intro: We are an independent AI research lab based in Madrid, Spain. Our work focuses on the development of open AI research projects that have a positive impact on society. We are currently focused on making Spanish historical archives more accessible.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: We believe the best way to advance AI research is through openness. By releasing datasets, models, and code as open-source, people can use them, improve them, and push the field forward together.

goals.heading: Our Goals
items: Contribute to AI research through open datasets, tools, and models that serve the public good
Contribute to Spain's growing role in the global AI landscape

funding.heading: Funding
funding.body: We are currently self-funded, using our own resources to bootstrap this initiative.
